candidate.answerReason: Triangle AHB is right at H, and M is the midpoint of its hypotenuse AB. The median to the hypotenuse has length AB/2=6.5.

methods.label: Use the median of the smaller right triangle
methods.explanation:
The altitude creates a useful smaller triangle: since \(H\) lies on \(BC\) and \(AH\perp BC\), triangle \(AHB\) is right at \(H\). Its hypotenuse is \(AB\).

Because \(M\) is the midpoint of \(AB\), segment \(HM\) is the median from the right-angle vertex to the hypotenuse. In a right triangle, this median equals half the hypotenuse. Hence
\[
HM=\frac{AB}{2}=\frac{13}{2}=\boxed{6.5}.
\]
The other two side lengths are unnecessary. The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
